Implement applyPatch for JSON Patch (RFC 6902)

Adds applyPatch(document, patch) with the six operations add, remove,
replace, move, copy and test. Operations apply in order on a copy of the
input, so the input is never mutated, and invalid patches or failing
operations throw. Reuses the JSON Pointer parsing of resolvePointer.
